title: Halyeeygii Daadka Weyn
intro: Qofkani wuxuu ahaa tiir dulqaad qarniyo badan, isagoo bulsho caasi ah ugu yeeray iftiinka runta isagoo wajahaya jeesjees iyo diidmo. Iyadoo ay jiraan caqabado badan iyo culays farriin ah oo jiilal badan, addoonkan wuxuu ku adkaystay hawshiisa ilaa laga soo saaro amarkii ugu dambeeyay.
clues: Waxaan ku qaatay sagaal boqol iyo konton sano oo aan dadkayga ugu yeerayo waddada xaqnimada, habeen iyo maalinba, si qarsoodi ah iyo si dadbanba.
Waxaan uga digay dadkayga ciqaab daran, haddana waxay faraha geliyeen dhegahooda oo waxay isku dabooleen dharkooda iyagoo kibir badan.
Waxaa la i faray inaan wax weyn dhiso iyadoo indhaha Rabbigeyga ay ilaalinayaan, inkastoo aysan jirin wax biyo ah oo muuqda.
Intii aan shaqeynayay, hoggaamiyeyaasha dadkaygu way i soo ag mareen oo way igu jeesjeeseen, laakiin waxaan u sheegay in dhawaan aanu noqon doono kuwa ku jeesjeesaya.
Waxaan baryay in jidhkayga iyo dhiiggayguba ay ila soo biiraan, laakiin waxay doorteen inay magan galaan buur, iyagoo aaminsan inay ka badbaadin doonto mowjadaha sii kordhaya.
Markabkii aan saarnaa ugu dambeyntii wuxuu ku fadhiistay Buurta Judi ka dib markii dhulku liqay biyihii cirkana uu joojiyay roobkii.
arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
